description: Labelled requester utterances for Hawa's message understanding (requester-turn.ts planner vocabulary). Labels say what a human office member would take the words to mean in the given context; "unclear" means asking is the right answer. Sorani labels and synthetic Sorani phrasing need native review before they are treated as ground truth.

contexts.none: The chat has no design on the way (planned against an empty chat).
contexts.designing: One design (A, "Quality Assurance Workshop") is being made; its brief arrived 5 minutes ago.
contexts.in_review: Design A's draft is with the office for approval (in_review).
contexts.awaiting_answer: The office sent design A back; it waits for the requester's changes (awaiting_answer, rev 3).
contexts.delivered: Design A was delivered an hour ago (delivered, sent to the chat).
contexts.just_cancelled: The requester withdrew a design a minute ago (closed, so not listed); another design (B, "Teacher Appreciation Day") is being made.
contexts.two_open: Design A is with the office (in_review, 6 minutes ago); design B ("Teacher Appreciation Day") is being made (designing, 3 minutes ago).

pendingAsks.change_or_new: The bot just asked "Is this a change to Quality Assurance Workshop, or a new design?" about the words "Quality Assurance Workshop, 22 October".

fields.expected.intent: The planner intent a human would choose.
fields.expected.alsoAccept: Other intents that lead to an equally right outcome (used sparingly; see README).
fields.expected.target: The design the words are about: A, B, both, or ask (the bot should ask which); a list accepts any.
fields.expected.refusalOnly/question/redo/undo/: Finer readings, reported but not scored as intent.
